basics.name: Timo Karjala
basics.label: Senior Hands-on Software Crafter, Architect, Team lead
basics.summary:
With close to two decades of experience in the IT industry, Timo brings deep hands-on expertise in modern software development practices.

A disciplined practitioner of the engineering mindset and test-driven development, Timo embeds quality, clarity, and adaptability into the development process from day one.

His product development approach is rooted in lean principles: minimizing cycle time, managing variability, validating early, and accelerating feedback loops to maximize value delivery.

Timo enjoys working in learning-driven organizations, where technical excellence, continuous improvement, and aligned execution are core to building successful teams.
basics.x-tagline: In a modern organization it is the team, not the individual, that learns — and once teams learn, the whole organization learns with them.

projects.name: IoT data platform
projects.x-note: The highlight slide gives 2019-2022, covering also the preceding consultancy period on the same platform; the project list dates are used.
projects.description:
Led the development of the client's IoT data platform on AWS for collecting engine sensor data from vessels, power plants and other sites around the world, consisting of millions of signals with potentially 1hz resolution.

The data is pre-processed on the platform targeting different use cases and served to several internal departments and external customers with various requirements per consumer.

The platform is built on streaming data powered by the Kafka stack. Several types of devices collect the data, with some registered in AWS IoT while others rely on in-house systems to connect. Ingestion is managed with HiveMQ. Data processors run as Kafka Streams based microservices on Kubernetes, routing data with Ksql, sinking to InfluxDb and S3 via Kafka Connect to offer real-time, API-based and file-based consumption methods.

Timo was responsible for the product roadmap & management of two development teams with 6 members each, mixing data engineers, developers and cloud architects, co-creating the evolving platform architecture, hands-on development, facilitation, coaching and mentoring team members.

The real impact of the teams' work was the boost the platform gave to the service business as the foundation for the AI-driven uptime and efficiency services enabling top-tier agreements.
